what_this_is: The recorded vision-consistency check the card requires: one row per shipped plate, each compared against the model sheet, which ART-BIBLE.md §7.4 makes the only style reference for a pose. Every row records what a vision pass actually reported plus the silhouette numbers measured by scripts/cp010-shape-audit.py. A check without a record is not a check.

method.vision_pass: host image-understanding model, one call per plate; for the model sheet one call over the whole four-view plate plus a 150 % crop of the front view; for point a second call on a 250 % mid-body crop. Vision reads are treated as weak evidence, so every claim they make about geometry is cross-checked against the silhouette audit.
method.silhouette: audit/cp010-fox/shape-audit.json — opaque-alpha bbox and aspect, re-derived from the shipped PNGs.
method.lettering: tesseract 5, default psm 3, on each master; the TSV is kept beside it and no word of two or more characters reaches 70 confidence.
method.palette: audit/cp010-fox/art-audit.json — per-plate pigment share and pure-black share.

marking_band.definition: Dark limb marking counted as a match when it is a cuff at the end of the limb — the paw plus the wrist or ankle — with fur above it and nothing approaching the elbow. Measured, not chosen: ART-BIBLE.md §3 states the band from the numbers below.
marking_band.measured_on_the_sheet: front view of the model sheet: solid dark band 60-61 px on the arms and 68-70 px on the feet against a 607 px figure (9.9-10.0 % and 11.2-11.5 %); arm band top edge at 65.1-65.7 % of figure height, foot band top at 87.8-88.1 %, fur above both. scripts/cp010-marking-audit.py, recorded in audit/cp010-fox/marking-audit.json.

rows.stance: four views (front, three-quarter left, side, back), upright and bipedal in all four

markings.limb_marking: a dark cuff at the end of each limb with fur above it: 60-61 px on the arms and 68-70 px on the feet of a 607 px front view, measured by scripts/cp010-marking-audit.py; no view carries dark up the limb

rows.colour_family: warm rust fur, cream bib and tail tip, dark brown limb ends and line — inside the post-temper family recorded in the art bible
rows.notes: The sheet is the authority and is internally consistent across the four views.

rows.stance: upright, bipedal, two feet down, one paw raised to ear height

markings.limb_marking: paw only on the arms; the legs are dark up to the knee

rows.colour_family: same family; fur and cream inside a few units of the recorded post-temper values
rows.notes: Neutral arms-down plate and the only one where the neck-pinch head estimate is meaningful: 53.3 % of figure height.

rows.stance: upright, bipedal, two feet down, one front paw extended down-right in a pointing gesture

markings.limb_marking: paw only on the arms and feet

rows.notes: Round 3. Round 1 was a quadruped (aspect 1.076) and is recorded as rejected in prompts.json; round 2 was bipedal but both arms hung at the side, so it had no gesture. The pointing paw is a mitten with a thumb and one internal line, matching the sheet's paws — checked on a 500 % nearest-neighbour crop of this master. An earlier draft of this row said the fingers separate; that was a vision read recorded as fact and is corrected here.

rows.stance: upright, bipedal, holding a small alarm clock at chest height

markings.limb_marking: paw plus a short cuff to the lower forearm — the longest cuff in the set, still short of the elbow

rows.lettering: none; the clock face carries tick marks only, no numerals
rows.notes: Round 2, regenerated because round 1's cuff stopped short of the wrist.

rows.stance: seated upright with an open book in both paws; the one non-standing pose besides sleep
rows.lettering: none; the book pages carry ruled lines, no glyphs
rows.notes: Seated, so the aspect guard is asserted at the standing-pose limit and passes at 0.799.

rows.stance: upright, bipedal, both paws raised, head tilted up

markings.limb_marking: paw plus a short cuff just past the wrist and ankle

rows.notes: Raised arms make the widest row the arms, so no head-fraction estimate is reported.

rows.stance: upright, bipedal, front paws raised to the chin

markings.limb_marking: paw with a short cuff to the wrist and ankle

rows.notes: One paw at the chin with the other arm bent and its paw resting near the chest — the bible's one-paw description, not two. The head tilt is slight and was not measured against the bible's 15°.

rows.stance: curled asleep, lying; the deliberate exception to the upright stance guard

markings.limb_marking: dark paw at the pad; no cuff visible in the curled pose

rows.notes: Only plate whose aspect is above 1.0; the stance guard asserts that exception explicitly rather than exempting the file.

open_items.finding: ART-BIBLE.md §3 and the card body required dark socks from the paw to the elbow. No shipped plate implements that, including the model sheet the rule describes. Measured on the sheet's front view (scripts/cp010-marking-audit.py): the solid dark band is 60-61 px on the arms and 68-70 px on the feet against a 607 px figure, with fur above it and nothing approaching the elbow. The rule was therefore a target that the authority itself does not meet.
open_items.why_it_matters: CP-011, CP-012 and CP-013 inherit this bible. A rule the authority violates propagates as an unmeetable instruction.
options: Amend §3 to the marking the family and the sheet actually share: dark paw plus at most a short cuff, lower leg dark to the ankle.
Hold the rule and regenerate the model sheet (one round left) and then all seven poses from the new sheet; the poses would exceed their per-pose round budget.
open_items.resolution: Option 1, by supervisor ruling 2026-11-10 05:45 MST: §3 now states the measured cuff band and names itself the authority. Reversible by the owner. No plate regenerated.

open_items.finding: Neither contact sheet is signed, and the poses were generated before the sheet was approved — the order ART-BIBLE.md §7.3 and the card body require.
open_items.why_it_matters: Acceptance for this card is the owner's signature on both sheets; the art cannot be accepted by a reviewer on the owner's behalf.
options: Sign the sheet, then the pose sheet.
Reject the sheet; the seven poses are then regenerated from the replacement.

open_items.finding: §3 gave the head as 45 % of standing figure height. The only plate where the silhouette permits a neck-pinch estimate (wave, arms down) measures 53.3 %, and the model sheet itself cannot be measured per view by silhouette slicing.
open_items.why_it_matters: A proportion table that a new plate cannot meet produces either an off-model plate or a re-litigated rule.
options: Keep 45 % as the design target and record 53.3 % as the measured family value with its method.
Adopt 53 % as the rule and re-state the tolerance.
open_items.resolution: Option 1, by supervisor ruling 2026-11-10 05:45 MST: §3 states 45-55 % of standing height with 45 % as the target and 53.3 % as the measured value; §4 cites §3 instead of restating a number. The six unmeasurable poses are accepted as-is for this submission. Reversible by the owner.

open_items.finding: The think plate matches the bible's one-paw-at-the-chin description, but the head tilt is slight and was never measured against the stated 15°, and the free arm is bent across the chest rather than hanging at the side.
open_items.why_it_matters: Pose descriptions in the bible are inherited by later scene cards, and an unmeasured angle reads as a rule that a new plate can fail without anyone being able to check it.
options: Drop the exact angle from the description and keep the gesture.
Measure the tilt on the shipped plate and state the observed value.
